company.name: Tariq & Co. Tech
company.tagline: Engineering the Future. Building What Matters.
company.positioning: Technology company building software solutions, digital experiences, and business automation for small and growing businesses.

core_services.name: Full-Stack Web Development
core_services.target_problem: Business needs an online presence or web tool that works properly and scales.
deliverables: Business websites & landing pages with inquiry flows
Custom web applications tailored to operational workflows
User accounts, authentication, and role-based access

core_services.name: Workflow Automation
core_services.target_problem: Teams wasting hours manually copying data, updating spreadsheets, or sending repetitive messages.
deliverables: Connected workflows between existing tools (CRMs, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, email)
Automated record updates without human error
Order and inquiry routing straight into databases

core_services.name: UI/UX Design & Usability Optimization
core_services.target_problem: Product or website is crowded, outdated, or confusing, causing visitors to bounce or drop off.

core_services.name: AI Integration & Smart Workflows
core_services.target_problem: Slow manual tasks (content creation, assessments, document extraction) or lagging apps with unoptimized AI.
deliverables: In-app AI features (content generation, smart search)
Document processing and intelligent data extraction
Background job queues (BullMQ/Redis) so long-running AI tasks don't block the UI

core_services.name: Technical Consulting & Scoping
core_services.target_problem: Founder or business has an idea but lacks a clear technical plan, scope, or architecture.
deliverables: Clear written scope and timeline before code starts
Phased delivery milestones with zero tech jargon

case_studies.name: VidaAI
case_studies.problem: AI assessment generation took time and blocked requests, damaging user experience.
case_studies.solution: Built background worker queues with BullMQ and Redis; users receive live progress updates without waiting on lagging requests.

case_studies.name: University Website & Dynamic CMS
case_studies.problem: Static website required a software developer for every text and announcement change.
case_studies.solution: Custom dynamic CMS with an admin panel allowing non-technical staff to manage announcements, faculty directories, and media.

case_studies.name: Yousafzai Agri Foods
case_studies.problem: Lacked a credible public presence; manual buyer inquiries and price quotes took excessive staff time.
case_studies.solution: Structured digital B2B catalog with direct quote request workflow and a dedicated backend PMS for live updates without code.
relevance_trigger: Manufacturers with static product PDFs or messy inquiry forms

case_studies.name: Crispiano Café
case_studies.problem: Customer orders and inquiries were scattered chaotically across Instagram and Facebook DMs.
case_studies.solution: Warm hospitality visual experience with streamlined menu structure and a one-click WhatsApp direct ordering path.
relevance_trigger: Local bakeries relying only on chaotic social media DMs

case_studies.name: AI Business SaaS
case_studies.problem: Traditional business dashboards are overly complex with too many menus, confusing non-technical owners.
case_studies.solution: Plain-language command interface powered by Gemini API translating plain English into database actions in ~3s.

spam_prevention: Strictly plain-text feel (no heavy HTML, no tracking pixels on initial email)
Zero spam-trigger buzzwords (e.g., 'guaranteed', '100% free', 'make money fast', 'act now')
Always reference a specific, verified issue on their actual website
Soft, non-pushy Call-to-Action (e.g., 'Open to seeing a quick 60-second video?' or 'Can I send a 2-point fix?')
Offer direct WhatsApp chat (+92 314 9574681) for fast friction-free response
